findings.highlight: His body, which Archer sliced in two before my eyes, is whole once more
findings.evidenceJa: アーチャーに断たれた半身も健在
findings.governingReading: even the half of his body severed by Archer is intact
findings.explanation: The specific restoration of Zouken’s severed half becomes a whole body previously bisected, with an unsupported eyewitness detail.
The temporal anchor to the prior night disappears.

findings.highlight: I don’t know how he did it
findings.governingReading: the Magecraft or reason for his recovery is unknown
findings.explanation: The ruby linking the unknown reason to Magecraft disappears from Shirou’s inference.

findings.highlight: a piece of one’s body that has been lost
findings.evidenceJa: 無くなった肉体、失われた肉体
findings.governingReading: the absent or lost body itself
findings.explanation: The scale of restoring lost flesh or body is narrowed to replacing a piece.
The setting-specific method is rendered as generic magic.

findings.evidenceJa: 不死身と呼ばれるものではないのか
findings.governingReading: would this not count as an undying or invulnerable body
findings.explanation: Shirou’s question about bodily indestructibility is shifted toward the distinct concept of immortality.

findings.governingReading: a keisaku or temple admonitory stick
findings.explanation: The specific temple implement Shirou Reinforces is reduced to a generic stick.
The quotation-marked named technique becomes an unmarked ordinary adjective.

findings.highlight: will never be able to match him
findings.evidenceJa: どうにかできる相手じゃない
findings.governingReading: not an opponent he can do anything about with one stick
findings.explanation: Inability to overcome or affect Zouken becomes inability to equal him.

findings.governingReading: something writhes with a shrill kii-kii sound
findings.explanation: The first audible cue identifying the creatures disappears.

findings.governingReading: a densely packed swarm of insects
findings.explanation: mirror moon narrows the scene’s generic insects to worms.

findings.governingReading: the true identity of the darkness is
findings.explanation: A completed recognition is weakened into probability.

findings.evidenceJa: お堂の四隅、壁という壁
findings.governingReading: all four corners of the hall and every wall
findings.explanation: The insects’ coverage of the hall’s four corners is omitted.
mirror moon fixes the earlier attack to yesterday.
The concrete abdominal wound is generalized, erasing the repeated 腹 that then means intent in Zouken’s taunt.

findings.highlight: It’s obvious that he is enjoying this
findings.evidenceJa: 蟲遣いは明らかに愉しんでいる
findings.governingReading: the insect-user is plainly enjoying himself
findings.explanation: Zouken’s role as controller of the swarm is omitted.
The swarm’s stated order of magnitude is reduced.

findings.evidenceJa: 人間一人をどうにかできる
findings.governingReading: do something decisive to a single human being
findings.explanation: Shirou’s uncertain euphemism about incapacitation or worse is resolved specifically as killing.

findings.highlight: I shall wait as long as you want
findings.evidenceJa: ワシは幾らでも待とう
findings.governingReading: Zouken will wait for as long as he pleases
findings.explanation: Control over the duration of the standoff shifts from Zouken to Shirou.
